```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

## Input Files

```{r}
resolve_existing_path <- function(candidates) {
  existing <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(existing) == 0) {
    stop(
      "Could not find the power output directory. Checked:\n",
      paste(candidates, collapse = "\n")
    )
  }
  existing[[1]]
}

# See the note in Power_Output_Visualization.Rmd: the 2026-08 directory is the
# local re-run that includes GRAPHS, ATLAA and SWSD; Power_Output/ is the May
# SLURM run that predates them. Fresh run first, May run as fallback.
power_dir <- resolve_existing_path(c(
  "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Power_Output_2026-08/Between_Study",
  "Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Power_Output_2026-08/Between_Study",
  "../../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Power_Output/Between_Study",
  "../../Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Power_Output/Between_Study",
  "Output/Paper1_Output_Submission2/Power_Output/Between_Study"
))
message("power_dir = ", normalizePath(power_dir, mustWork = FALSE))

power_results_file <- file.path(power_dir, "between_study_quantile_power_results.csv")
screening_results_file <- file.path(power_dir, "between_study_quantile_power_screening.csv")
summary_file <- file.path(power_dir, "between_study_quantile_power_collection_summary.csv")
missing_tasks_file <- file.path(power_dir, "between_study_quantile_power_missing_tasks.csv")
mapping_file <- resolve_existing_path(c(
  "../../../Input/Harmonized_Datasets/Targeted_Analyte_Category_Mapping.csv",
  "../../Input/Harmonized_Datasets/Targeted_Analyte_Category_Mapping.csv",
  "../Input/Harmonized_Datasets/Targeted_Analyte_Category_Mapping.csv",
  "Input/Harmonized_Datasets/Targeted_Analyte_Category_Mapping.csv"
))

power_results <- readr::read_csv(power_results_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
screening_results <- readr::read_csv(screening_results_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
collection_summary <- readr::read_csv(summary_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
analyte_mapping <- readr::read_csv(mapping_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  distinct(Code, Category)
missing_tasks <- if (file.exists(missing_tasks_file)) {
  readr::read_csv(missing_tasks_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
} else {
  tibble()
}

location_models <- c(
  "Location",
  "Location_Center",
  "Location_Region",
  "Location_Study",
  "Location_Year"
)

power_results <- power_results %>%
  filter(model_name %in% location_models)

screening_results <- screening_results %>%
  filter(model_name %in% location_models)

if (nrow(power_results) == 0) {
  stop("No location-based between-study power results were found in: ", power_results_file)
}

model_levels <- c(
  sort(unique(power_results$model_name)),
  sort(unique(screening_results$model_name))
) %>%
  unique() %>%
  stats::na.omit() %>%
  as.character()

pretty_model_name <- function(x) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    x == "Study" ~ "Study",
    x == "Year" ~ "Year",
    TRUE ~ stringr::str_replace_all(x, "_", " + ")
  )
}

power_results <- power_results %>%
  left_join(analyte_mapping, by = c("analyte" = "Code")) %>%
  mutate(
    tau = factor(tau, levels = sort(unique(tau))),
    analysis = recode(analysis, between_study = "Between-study"),
    panel = recode(str_to_title(panel), Maternal = "Adult"),
    model_name = factor(model_name, levels = model_levels),
    model_label = factor(pretty_model_name(model_name), levels = pretty_model_name(model_levels)),
    Category = replace_na(Category, "Unmapped")
  )

screening_results <- screening_results %>%
  left_join(analyte_mapping, by = c("analyte" = "Code")) %>%
  mutate(
    analysis = recode(analysis, between_study = "Between-study"),
    panel = recode(str_to_title(panel), Maternal = "Adult"),
    model_name = factor(model_name, levels = model_levels),
    model_label = factor(pretty_model_name(model_name), levels = pretty_model_name(model_levels)),
    Category = replace_na(Category, "Unmapped")
  )

model_palette <- stats::setNames(
  rep(as.character(paletteer::paletteer_d("ggsci::default_igv")), length.out = length(model_levels)),
  pretty_model_name(model_levels)
)

panel_palette <- stats::setNames(
  as.character(paletteer::paletteer_d("ggsci::default_igv")[1:2]),
  c("Child", "Adult")
)

category_levels <- power_results %>%
  distinct(Category) %>%
  arrange(Category) %>%
  pull(Category)

category_palette_base <- c(
  "FlameRetardants" = "#FFD23F",
  "Flame_Retardant" = "#FFD23F",
  "PAH" = "#6C8FD9",
  "Parabens" = "#9AA3AD",
  "PCB" = "#D7B07A",
  "PCBs" = "#D7B07A",
  "Pesticides" = "#FF6B3A",
  "Pesticide" = "#FF6B3A",
  "PFAS" = "#D8E58A",
  "Phenols" = "#2D8FD5",
  "Phthalates" = "#F45A2A",
  "TraceElements" = "#69C3EC",
  "Trace_Elements" = "#69C3EC",
  "Smoking" = "#4C8A2B",
  "VOC" = "#4B0D57",
  "VOCs" = "#4B0D57"
)

category_palette_fallback <- stats::setNames(
  rep(as.character(paletteer::paletteer_d("ggsci::springfield_simpsons")), length.out = length(category_levels)),
  category_levels
)

category_palette <- category_palette_fallback
matched_categories <- intersect(names(category_palette_base), category_levels)
category_palette[matched_categories] <- category_palette_base[matched_categories]

power_theme <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "#14213D"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "#4F5D75"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#14213D"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "#2B2D42"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#14213D"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#E6E8EF", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#D9DEE8", linewidth = 0.35),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA)
    )
}

model_power_dist <- power_results %>%
  group_by(panel, model_label) %>%
  summarise(
    models = n(),
    median_power = median(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

category_power_dist <- power_results %>%
  group_by(panel, model_label, Category) %>%
  summarise(
    models = n(),
    median_power = median(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

power_by_covariate <- power_results %>%
  mutate(covariates_used = replace_na(covariates_used, "")) %>%
  tidyr::separate_rows(covariates_used, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(
    covariates_used = stringr::str_trim(covariates_used),
    covariate_type = dplyr::case_when(
      covariates_used == "" ~ NA_character_,
      covariates_used %in% c("Child_Age", "Mat_Age") ~ "Age",
      covariates_used %in% c("Child_Sex", "Adult_Sex") ~ "Sex",
      covariates_used %in% c("Mat_Race", "Child_Race", "Mat_Child_Comb_Race") ~ "Race",
      covariates_used %in% c("Mat_Edu", "Edu_Any", "Mat_Edu_Binary") ~ "Education",
      covariates_used %in% c("Mat_Income", "Mat_Income_Binary", "Family_Income_Cont") ~ "Income",
      covariates_used %in% c("Sample_Collection_Year", "Year") ~ "Time",
      covariates_used %in% c("Study", "Location", "Location_Region", "Center", "Location_Country", "Site_Location", "State", "Country") ~ "Geography/Study",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(covariate_type)) %>%
  distinct(task_id, analyte, tau, panel, analysis, model_name, model_label, covariate_type, power, observed_p, n, n_studies)
```

```{r}
screening_ok_tbl <- screening_results %>%
  filter(status == "ok") %>%
  group_by(panel, model_label) %>%
```

## Power Summary

```{r}
power_summary_tbl <- power_results %>%
  group_by(panel, model_label, tau) %>%
  summarise(
    models = n(),
    median_power = median(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_power = mean(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_observed_p = median(observed_p, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_n = median(n, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_n_studies = median(n_studies, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(power_summary_tbl, digits = 3)
```

## Top Powered Results

```{r}
top_power_tbl <- power_results %>%
  arrange(desc(power), observed_p, panel, model_label, analyte) %>%
  select(panel, model_label, analyte, tau, n, n_studies, power, observed_p, mcse) %>%
  slice_head(n = 25)

kable(top_power_tbl, digits = 3)
```

## Plot 1: Power Distribution by Tau

```{r}
p_power_hist <- power_results %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = power, fill = model_label)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 28, alpha = 0.8, position = "identity", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ tau) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = model_palette) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Estimated Power",
    subtitle = "Power estimates across quantiles for between-study model families",
    x = "Estimated power",
    y = "Number of analyte-model results",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
  power_theme()

p_power_hist
```

## Plot 2: Median Power by Tau and Model

```{r}
p_median_power <- power_results %>%
  group_by(panel, model_label, tau) %>%
  summarise(
    median_power = median(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = tau, y = median_power, color = model_label, group = model_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.15) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel) +
  scale_color_manual(values = model_palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Power Across Quantiles",
    subtitle = "Comparison of the between-study Study and Year model families",
    x = "Tau",
    y = "Median power",
    color = "Model"
  ) +
  power_theme()

p_median_power
```

## Plot 8: Power by Demographic Variable Type

```{r}
covariate_type_levels <- c(
  "Age",
  "Sex",
  "Race",
  "Education",
  "Income",

)

p_covariate_power <- power_by_covariate %>%
```

## Suggested Supplementary Figure Panel

```{r fig.width=16, fig.height=18}
supp_fig_a <- power_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(model_name == "Location") %>% 
  group_by(panel, model_label, tau) %>%
  summarise(
    median_power = median(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(power, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(power, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = tau, y = median_power, color = model_label, group = model_label, fill = model_label)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), alpha = 0.14, linewidth = 0, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ panel) +
  scale_color_manual(values = model_palette) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = model_palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "A. Median power across quantiles",
    x = "Tau",
    y = "Median power",
    color = "Model"
  ) +
  power_theme()

supp_fig_b <- power_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(model_name == "Location") %>% 

  ggplot(aes(x = power, fill = model_label)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 22, alpha = 0.84, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ model_label, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = model_palette) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Model-specific power distributions",
    x = "Estimated power",
    y = "Results",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
  power_theme()

supp_fig_c <- power_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(model_name == "Location") %>% 

  group_by(panel, model_label, Category) %>%
  summarise(
    median_power = median(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    models = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(Category %in% top_categories_hist$Category) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = median_power, y = forcats::fct_reorder(Category, median_power), fill = Category)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.64, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ model_label) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = category_palette, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "C. Category-level median power",
    x = "Median power",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  power_theme()

supp_fig_d <- power_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(model_name == "Location") %>% 

  ggplot(aes(x = n_studies, y = power, color = panel)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.18, width = 0.15, height = 0, size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.0, method = "loess", span = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ model_label) +
  scale_color_manual(values = panel_palette) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "D. Contributing studies versus power",
    x = "Number of contributing studies",
    y = "Estimated power",
    color = "Panel"
  ) +
  power_theme()

supp_patchwork <- (
  supp_fig_a /
  supp_fig_b /
  (supp_fig_c + supp_fig_d)
) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Power characteristics of between-study censored quantile models",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17, color = "#14213D"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "#4F5D75")
    )
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

supp_patchwork + plot_layout(guides = "collect", heights = c(0.9, 1.0, 1.1))
```
